stockDetail.overview: WisdomTree Commodity Securities Limited, formerly ETFS Commodity Securities Limited, is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company's principal activity is the issue and listing of commodity securities (Commodity Securities). The Company has two operating segments; Classic & Longer Dated Commodity Contracts and Short & Leveraged Commodity Contracts. The Company provides accessible investment solutions, enabling investors to intelligently diversify their portfolios beyond traditional asset classes and strategies. The Company offers a ranges of specialist exchange traded products (ETPs) covering commodities, foreign exchange (FX), fixed income and equities traded on major exchanges across the world.
